method: Deterministic stratified sample: two apps from each of the ten categories. Five claims per app were checked against first-party documentation: auth, credential access, API surface, MCP status, and verdict.
residualUncertainty: Four of 100 sampled field judgments remain directional because the vendor exposes no public developer material or requires an account to inspect it.
